description: This file defines a custom exception class 'CalendarNotFoundException' used in the Fineract project. It extends a base exception to handle cases where a calendar resource is not found.

classes.name: CalendarNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception thrown when a calendar resource cannot be found, extending the base not-found exception and providing constructors for different scenarios.

methods.name: CalendarNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with an error message indicating the calendar with the given ID does not exist.

methods.name: CalendarNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructs the exception, including an underlying data access exception cause for more detailed error context.
